basic_info.description: Designed by eminent architect Stephen A. Roake, the Church Street Gardens complex is a true oasis. This beautifully updated and modern 2bd/2ba townhouse-like condo is located in the heart of Mission Dolores. On the first level, a functional & open floor plan offers ample natural light, hardwood flooring, living room entertainment system, and a kitchen and dining room that are perfect for entertaining or having a quiet night in. The fully updated kitchen boasts high end appliances, wine fridge, Heath tile backsplash and custom cabinets. The living room, with its expansive 16' ceilings and floor-to-ceiling windows, opens onto a large private outdoor space that extends onto a beautifully maintained courtyard. Upstairs, the generously sized primary suite features custom closets, beautiful greenery outlooks, and a tastefully updated en suite bathroom. The laundry closet features side-by-side Miele washer/dryer with added shelving. A second updated full bath with tub and a spacious second bedroom round out the upper level. Deeded 2-car garage parking & large private storage included. Building offers earthquake insurance, a meticulously maintained courtyard, barbecue, and outdoor shower and sauna. Easy access to MUNI, 99 WalkScore and ample options for dining and retail.
